instruction: A candid outdoor full shot captures a sunny grassy park with tall trees in the background. On the left, the Black woman in a black beanie and red t-shirt (R5) leans forward in a deep squat, pulling a yellow rope with a joyful smile. Behind her on the right, the East Asian man in a red polo shirt (R3) crouches low, pulling the rope with a strained grin. They are playing a competitive game of tug-of-war together, holding onto the rope with both hands. The scene is illuminated by bright, natural daylight, casting soft shadows on the green grass.
elements: R5 is the forward, deep-squatting rope puller
R3 crouches low behind R5 while pulling the rope
